_comment: Sub-questions for the C13 retrieval evaluation (REFERENCE.md 4.5).
These are RETRIEVAL queries, not benchmark questions — they are the
kind of sub-question the planner emits at C16, and they exist to
exercise the retriever, not the agent.
Chosen to span the failure modes the two arms have:
- exact identifiers (method and model names) where dense blurs
- paraphrases with no shared vocabulary where sparse fails
- numeric/result lookups where section filtering matters
- contested topics where sources genuinely disagree
seed_arxiv_ids are ingested full-text so the corpus contains real
Results and Related Work sections rather than abstracts alone.
